clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked into the jagged cliffs of the Valley of the Watchers in southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum consist of an ancient stone hall guarding a sealed Titan facility. Massive stone doors protect its secrets from grave robbers and curious explorers alike.

Carved deep into the bedrock of southern Tanaris, the Ruins of Uldum appear to be an antechamber or grand threshold to a far larger, sealed subterranean complex. Its colossal stone gates stand shut against the outside world, and no mechanism or key known to modern scholars has managed to open them.
